item.title: GitHub mutuals on AI in life sciences or bioinformatics
item.description:
Dear all.

Does anybody here build applications for AI in life sciences or bioinformatics? I would love to be mutuals and connected on my github account here: https://github.com/Johnkecops

Here are some examples on what I built with my team:

Protein domain annotation pipeline from my dissertation: https://github.com/Johnkecops/protein-domain

Alzheimer Epigenetics annotation pipeline: https://github.com/Johnkecops/Alzheimer_Epigenetics

Camcer Epigenetics annotation pipeline: https://github.com/Johnkecops/Epigenetics

Please don't hesitate to ask or discuss anything about this field. I also welcome any interest for this field, if you want to know more. Thank you for your attention.

Show HN: Teacher Planner – A digital planbook with AI tools for teachers
item.description:
Hi HN, I built Teacher Planner to help teachers organize lessons and prepare classroom materials in one place.

The digital planbook brings together lesson plans, units, schedules, and curriculum standards, with day, week, and month views, read-only sharing, and configurable print layouts. It supports English and Chinese, and you can try the planner as a guest without creating an account.

Alongside the planner, there are five AI tools: a lesson plan generator, worksheet generator, multiple-choice quiz generator, text rewriter, and writing feedback tool. These help produce drafts that teachers can review and adapt for their classes.

I'd appreciate feedback from teachers and people building education software. Which parts of your planning and material preparation still take the most time, and where do existing tools fall short?
